latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CPA Firm Video — Accounting & Tax Practice Marketing Video Creator.

- Enables fast creation of professional marketing videos for CPA firms, tax preparers, and accounting practices.
- Supports a wide range of video types: tax deadline reminders, IRS audit explainers, client onboarding, service promos, and more.
- Designed for solo practitioners to multi-partner firms, including virtual CFOs and bookkeeping providers.
- Optimized video content for Google Business Profile, social media, YouTube, and local search to help firms stand out and build trust.
- Requires no video production experience; professional results in minutes.
